posts.title: Welcome to DevOps Hell. Here’s Your Map.
posts.description: Which version of which repo is running on which stage? I built fooboard to answer that from the browser, with no backend. Then I taught it to let your AI assistant set it up for you without ever seeing your keys.

posts.title: Semantic Back-Propagation: In The Wild
posts.description: The academic term describes optimizing LLM call chains in memory. We built something different: a closed-loop knowledge system where synthesis output feeds back into the search space that drives future synthesis. Here's how it works in production.

posts.title: Windows Broke My TEL → WhatsApp Links (So I Built a Router)
posts.description: A Windows update quietly killed my favorite productivity shortcut. Here’s what changed, how I fixed it, and the tiny app (and toolchain) that made it possible.
